SUPERIOR COURT OF NEW JERSEY
Superior Court
SHERIFF'S SALE NO. 26003379
DOCKET NO. F00496825
PLAINTIFF – NEWREZ LLC D/B/A SHELLPOINT MORTGAGE SERVICING
DEFENDANTS- DAVID R. PAGLIA; ET. ALS.
Writ of Execution.
By virtue of the above stated Writ of Execution to me directed and delivered I will expose for sale at public vendue on
Tuesday THE 15th DAY OF September 2026
between the hours of 1:30 pm and 5:00 pm in the afternoon of said day, that is to say at 1:30 P.M. the prevailing time at The Leroy F. Smith Building, 60 West Market Street, 14th Floor, Newark, NJ 07102 to wit:
All that tract or parcel of land, situate, lying and being in the of NUTLEY, County of Essex County and State of New Jersey:
Being known as:
LOT 9 BLOCK 5300
DIMENSIONS: 50.0FT X 118.65FT X 50.0FT X 118.65FT
NEAREST CROSS STREET: BLOOMFIELD AVENUE
PLEASE BE ADVISED THAT DEFINITIVE OCCUPANCY INFORMATION IS NOT AVAILABLE AND PLAINTIFF MAKES NO REPRESENTATION REGARDING OCCUPANCY.
GOOD FAITH ESTIMATED UPSET: $386,399.35
*Subject to any unpaid taxes, municipal liens or other charges, and any such taxes, charges, liens, insurance premiums or other advances made by plaintiff prior to this sale. All interested parties are to conduct and rely upon their own independent investigation to ascertain whether or not any outstanding interest remain of record and/or have priority over the lien being foreclosed and, if so the current amount due thereon.
**If the sale is set aside for any reason, the Purchaser at the sale shall be entitled only to a return of the deposit paid. The Purchaser shall have no further recourse against the Mortgagor, the Mortgagee or the Mortgagee's attorney.
****SUBJECT TO USA'S RIGHT OF REDEMPTION: PURSUANT TO 28, U.S.C. SECTION 2410, THIS SALE IS SUBJECT TO A 120 DAY RIGHT OF REDEMPTION HELD BY THE UNITED STATES OF AMERICA i.MORTGAGE DATED JUNE 22, 2021 FROM DAVID R. PAGLIA AND CHRISTINE M. PAGLIA TO SECRETARY OF HOUSING AND URBAN DEVELOPMENT RECORDED IN THE OFFICE OF THE ESSEX COUNTY CLERK ON AUGUST 4, 2021 IN INSTRUMENT NO. 2021095362 TO SECURE $45,061.27. ii. MORTGAGE DATED JANUARY 25, 2024 FROM DAVID R. PAGLIA AND CHRISTINE M. PAGLIA TO SECRETARY OF HOUSING AND URBAN DEVELOPMENT RECORDED IN THE OFFICE OF THE ESSEX COUNTY CLERK ON MARCH 7, 2024 IN INSTRUMENT NO. 2024013319 TO SECURE $36,926.10.
PLEASE TAKE NOTICE THAT THIS MATTER INVOLVES AN FHA-INSURED MORTGAGE LOAN AND MAY BE SUBJECT TO APPLICABLE HUD AND/OR CAFMV BIDDING REQUIREMENTS AND PROCEDURES. ANY BIDDING CONDUCTED AT SHERIFF'S SALE SHALL COMPLY WITH ALL APPLICABLE HUD GUIDELINES, INVESTOR REQUIREMENTS, AND COUNTY SHERIFF PROCEDURES, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO ANY APPLICABLE UPSET BID LIMITATIONS, ADVANCE NOTICE REQUIREMENTS, ADJOURNMENTS REQUIREMENTS, AND/OR READVERTISEMENT PROCEDURES. ALL PARTIES AND BIDDERS ARE RESPONSIBLE FOR CONDUCTING THEIR OWN DUE DILIGENCE REGARDING ANY APPLICABLE FHA/HUD REQUIREMENTS PRIOR TO SALE.
PREMISES COMMONLY KNOWN AS:
171 MOUNTAINVIEW AVE NUTLEY, NJ 07110
A more complete metes and bounds description can be found in the Office of the Essex County Sheriff.
Lien(s)/Taxes:
Note: The street address is merely given as a convenience to the bidders and is not a representation of fact on the part of the sheriff. The diagram or concise description does not constitute a full legal description of the premises, but it can be found in the Essex County Sheriff Office.
Subject to any unpaid taxes, municipal liens or other charges, and any such taxes, charges, liens, insurance premiums or other advances made by plaintiff prior to this sale. All interested parties are to conduct and rely upon their own independent investigation to ascertain whether or not any outstanding interest remain of record and/or have priority over the lien being foreclosed and, if so the current amount due thereon.
If the sale is set aside for any reason, the Purchaser at the sale shall be entitled only to a return of the deposit paid. The Purchaser shall have no further recourse against the Mortgagor, the Mortgagee and the Mortgagee’s attorney.
Surplus Money: If after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person's claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
The approximate amount due on this execution is $347,490.40 plus interest, cost, printers’ fees, Sheriff's fees and commission. The prior liens, as per affidavit of consideration are not a representation of fact on the part of the Sheriff.
Amir D. Jones
SHERIFF
Advertised
DATED: July 31, 2026
PINCUS LAW GROUP, PLLC
SUITE 309
FIVE GREENTREE CENTRE
525 ROUTE 73 NORTH
MARLTON, NJ 08053
516-699-8902
